name: Takanagi Yuuna
source:
Kind and cheerful classmate of protagonist.
Very popular in class because she speaks friendly to the boys.

Her academics are average and her demeanor is girlish. 

"Recently, I'm really interested in Maikuro-kun. I wonder why?"
